title: Schooling, Income, and HIV Risk in Malawi
brief_summary: This study is designed to evaluate a two-year randomized intervention in Malawi that provides cash transfers to current schoolgirls (and young women who have recently dropped out of school) to stay in (and return to) school in order to understand the possible effects of such programs on the sexual behavior of the beneficiaries and their subsequent HIV risk.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* female
* 13-22 years old
* never married
